changelog: Adds admin/reseller video management: Stock (shipped) videos can now be deleted, gated behind a simple session-scoped admin password (client-side only, matching this app's existing no-login trust model). A single 'Add to Stock' checkbox applies to either a direct Upload or an Import Playlist (which now also accepts a direct link to a single .mp4 file, no .m3u playlist file needed) - lets a reseller pre-load the videos a device should ship with through either path.
